set.st: June 1898: on the road back from Holy Hill, about 4 mi from Hartford, a man shot his companion, emptied his money bag (sworn at $1,028 in gold, silver, paper and change), dragged him down a slope and drove on to Hartford. He was arrested that night with $5.75; the bag and revolver were never found. Private farmland: permission. Pin is approximate, not the spot itself.
set.t: The money left in the buggy; if hidden, it lies along the Holy Hill road between the shooting spot and Hartford. Record only.
